message: Phase 1 MVP built and verified (build clean, 113/113 tests): tooling (esbuild+Vitest, manifest id teamsync, minAppVersion 1.4.0), PersonService roster with archive-preserving-history, OneOnOneService with carry-forward via pure checkbox parser extractOpenActionItems, GoalService with byte-for-byte-safe updateStatus, team dashboard fed by a pure metadata-cache model. Scaffold updated (ROUTER state, data-model schemas + carry-forward rule, stack versions, setup commands). Known follow-ups: stale services in one-on-one/goal commands after mid-session settings change; unused listActivePeople/listPersonNames; 21-day overdue threshold hardcoded; no lint.
